crossRefs.note: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding:
The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

translations.web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
translations.bsb: The slacker buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth.
translations.kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
translations.asv: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
